推荐各位书友阅读：寡村寡事第一卷：（柳大春）我的美师娘国色天香第437章只能撒谎（..la）女服务员哇哇叫着，她从未有过如此的快乐。
女服务员看了一眼，一下子就紧张了，她回头看了柳大春一眼，急忙说道：“是我老公的电话，你别动，千万别动，知道吗？！我接一下就挂。”
“好。”柳大春表面答应她，实际上，坏点子多着呢。
“老婆，你什么时候下班啊？我来接你！”手机那头是男人的声音。
“还早着呢，没那么快。嗯，嗯。”女服务员回头看了一眼柳大春，示意他快停下来。
“你那边是什么声音啊？”老公又有些疑惑的问道。
“没有，是大厅里客人的声音吧，有些嘈杂。”服务员马上撒谎道。
“哦，这样，你声音怎么这么颤抖？”手机那头老公还是听出了妻子声音的异常。
这种异常，女服务员自己也想控制。
但是柳大春太强了，那种强是可怕的强，女服务员感觉自己坠入深渊，深不见底，一片漆黑，直通繁衍之地的强。
“我，我，我没事啊。”女服务员脑子都空白了，不知道怎么回答了，只能敷衍着。
“不是，你这声音不对劲啊，你怎么了？而且你边上那啪啪的是什么声音啊？”手机那台老公认真询问道。
女服务员回头，想用手推推柳大春，但是推不到，也推不她。
女服务员几乎是哀求的眼神看向柳大春。
边颤抖着边对老公撒谎道：“是大厅的客人在拍打东西。”
这时，女服务员实在是忍不住，叫出了声。
叫出来她就后悔了，但她实在是忍不住了，太舒服了。
镇外面，派出所民警，鬼爷的混混人员，都已经部署在镇的各个巷子里，街道上，今晚就盯着那个怪胎。

这个镇本来就不大，布防起来还是容易的。
“问题是那个怪胎是不死的，之前打中了他几枪，都没死，这还怎么杀？”
“这个怪胎到底是什么啊？怎么来的？我第一次见怀孕一个多月就生下来活的，还能跑的，真是恶心的怪物。”黄天少没见过如此荒诞的事。
“邪物吧，岩石风水案你忘记了？”
“那就用刀，脑袋砍下来，总不可能还能活吧？”林冰雪解释道。
“你说的轻松，谁接近他啊，身手那么敏捷，攻击性还那么强，能近他身的都死了。”黄天少回答道。
“看看柳大春能不能帮上忙吧。”林冰雪回答道。
听到这个名字，黄天少一下子就好奇起来。
“上次，蝎犯罪集团真的是被柳大春血洗的？”黄天少总是不信。
对林冰雪来说她是矛盾的，一边柳大春救了她；一边柳大春又犯法了；
“好吧，等他。”黄天少现在也是没有好的办法。..la

Recommended reading for all book friends: The Little Village and the Little Things Volume 1: (Liu Dachun) My Beautician Wife is Beautiful and Fragrant Chapter 437 I Can Only Lie (..la) The waitress screamed, she had never been so happy.
The waitress glanced at it and suddenly became nervous. She looked back at Liu Dachun and said hurriedly: "It's my husband's call. Don't move. Don't move. Do you understand?! I'll answer the call and hang up."
"Okay." Liu Dachun promised her on the surface, but in fact, he had many bad ideas.
"Honey, when will you get off work? I'll pick you up!" There was a man's voice on the other end of the phone.
"It's still early, not so fast. Well, well." The waitress looked back at Liu Dachun and signaled him to stop quickly.
"What's that noise over there?" My husband asked again with some confusion.
"No, it's probably the noise from the guests in the lobby. It's a little noisy." The waiter immediately lied.
"Oh, so, why is your voice so trembling?" The husband on the other end of the phone still heard the abnormality in his wife's voice.
This anomaly is something the waitress herself wants to control.
But Liu Dachun was too strong, that kind of strength was terrifying, and the waitress felt like she was falling into an abyss, bottomless, pitch black, leading straight to the place of reproduction.
"I, I, I'm fine." The waitress's mind went blank and she didn't know how to answer, so she could only respond perfunctorily.
"No, there's something wrong with your voice. What's wrong with you? And what is that snapping sound next to you?" the husband on the phone asked seriously.
The waitress turned around and tried to push Liu Dachun with her hand, but she couldn't and couldn't push her.
The waitress looked at Liu Dachun with almost pleading eyes.
While shaking, she lied to her husband: "It's the guests in the lobby who are beating things."
At this time, the waitress couldn't help it and screamed.
She regretted calling it out, but she couldn't help it, it was so comfortable.
Outside the town, the police from the police station and Guiye's gangsters have been deployed in various alleys and streets of the town, keeping an eye on the freak tonight.
This town is not big, so it is easy to set up defenses.
"The problem is that the freak is immortal. I shot him several times before and he didn't die. How can I kill him?"
"What on earth is this freak? How did it come about? This is the first time I've seen one that was born alive after more than one month of pregnancy and was able to run away. It's such a disgusting monster." Huang Tianshao has never seen such a ridiculous thing.
"Evil thing, have you forgotten about the rock feng shui case?"
"Then use a knife to chop off the head. It's impossible to survive, right?" Lin Bingxue explained.
"It's easy for you to say, whoever gets close to him is so agile and aggressive, anyone who can get close to him will die." Huang Tianshao replied.
"Let's see if Liu Dachun can help." Lin Bingxue replied.
Upon hearing this name, Huang Tianshao suddenly became curious.
"Last time, the Scorpion criminal group was really wiped out by Liu Dachun?" Huang Tianshao always didn't believe it.
For Lin Bingxue, she was contradictory. On the one hand, Liu Dachun saved her; on the other hand, Liu Dachun broke the law again;
"Okay, wait for him." Huang Tianshao had no good solution now. ..la
